// PROBE — a completion path that calls the one closer, in the right order.
// The guard in tests/unit/risk-review-policy.test.ts must find BOTH methods
// hooked here and the finalize call AFTER the gap persistence.
export class ProbeOrchestrator {
    async extractBasicSummary(policyId: string) {
        await db.policy.update({ where: { id: policyId }, data: { status: "active" } })
        const { refreshProtectionScore } = await import("@/lib/services/gap-engine")
        await refreshProtectionScore("owner")
        const { closeReviewsByPolicyEvidence } = await import("@/lib/services/risk-review/service")
        await closeReviewsByPolicyEvidence({ policyId })
        return { status: "completed" }
    }

    private async executePipelineAttempt(policy: { id: string }) {
        const decidedGapSlugs = await this.persistAnalysisArtifacts({ policy })
        await db.policyAnalysisRun.updateMany({ where: { id: "run" }, data: { status: "completed" } })
        import("@/lib/services/risk-review/service")
            .then(({ closeReviewsByPolicyEvidence }) => closeReviewsByPolicyEvidence({ policyId: policy.id }))
            .catch(() => undefined)
        return decidedGapSlugs
    }

    private async executeStepWithRetry() {
        return null
    }
}
